hover.doc:
**@fit(v, oldMin, oldMax, newMin, newMax, shouldClamp?, shouldRound?)**

Pro. Linear interpolation between ranges.

`v`: A number. The number to map from the old range to the new one.  
`oldMin`: A number. The value of v that maps to newMin.  
`oldMax`: A number. The value of v that maps to newMax.  
`newMin`: A number. What oldMin maps to.  
`newMax`: A number. What oldMax maps to.  
`shouldClamp?`: True or false. true keeps the result within the new range; false when left out.  
`shouldRound?`: True or false. true rounds the result to the nearest whole number; false when left out.

_Datastar Pro._

[Reference](https://data-star.dev/reference/actions#fit)

Kotlin: `fit()`

hover.doc:
**@setAll(value, filter?)**

Sets every matching signal.

`value`: The value every matching signal is set to.  
`filter?`: An object of include and exclude. include picks the signals whose path it matches and exclude leaves out those it matches, each a regular expression or a string. Left out, it picks every signal.

[Reference](https://data-star.dev/reference/actions#setall)

Kotlin: `setAll()`

**data-on**

Attaches an event listener. `evt` is the event; `el` the element.

`data-on:<event>="expr"`

**Key casing:** the key is the event name, lowercased by the browser. For a camelCase event write `widget-loaded__case.camel`.

**Modifiers:** `__once`, `__passive`, `__capture`, `__case.camel|kebab|snake|pascal`, `__delay.500ms`, `__debounce.500ms`, `__throttle.500ms`, `__viewtransition`, `__window`, `__document`, `__outside`, `__prevent`, `__stop`

**Kotlin:** `dataOn()`, `dataOnClick()`, `dataOnSubmit()`, `dataOnChange()`, `dataOnInput()`, `dataOnKeydown()`, `dataOnFetch()`

**__debounce** on data-on

Debounce the event listener.

**Tags:**  
`.500ms`: the duration, in milliseconds, or `.1s` in seconds.  
`.leading`: Debounce with leading edge.  
`.notrailing`: Debounce without trailing edge.

`.leading` and `.notrailing` come after the duration.
